title: Understanding Mode Collapse in Diffusion Models under Classifier-Free Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2611.33719v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The use of classifier-free guidance in diffusion and flow models has proven critical to their empirical success, as it allows for the controllable generation of lower-temperature and higher-fidelity samples. Despite its widespread use, classifier-free guidance remains both empirically and theoretically poorly understood, owing to the difficulty of solving the associated transport equations for arbitrary normalizing flows. In this paper, we observe that the effects of classifier-free guidance arise from a mismatch between the representation capabilities of the conditional and unconditional distributions, wherein the conditional distribution exhibits higher complexity and fidelity. We propose an analytical model to capture this observation: the conditional distribution is a Gaussian mixture whose means lie on an ellipsoid, and the unconditional distribution is a single Gaussian approximating the mixture. translated_title: 理解无分类器引导下扩散模型中的模式坍缩
translated_abstract: 无分类器引导在扩散模型和流模型中的应用已被证明对其经验成功至关重要，因为它能够可控地生成更低温、更高保真度的样本。尽管被广泛使用，无分类器引导在实验和理论上仍然缺乏充分理解，原因在于难以针对任意归一化流求解相关的输运方程。在本文中，我们观察到无分类器引导的效果源于条件分布与无条件分布之间表示能力的不匹配，其中条件分布表现出更高的复杂性和保真度。我们提出了一个分析模型来刻画这一观察：条件分布是一个其均值位于椭球面上的高斯混合分布，而无条件分布是一个近似该混合分布的单一高斯分布。由该混合分布产生的流……
tldr: 本文提出一个条件分布为均值位于椭球面上的高斯混合、无条件分布为近似该混合的单一高斯的分析模型，揭示了无分类器引导下模式坍缩的根源在于条件分布与无条件分布表示能力的不匹配。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that mode collapse under classifier-free guidance arises from a mismatch in representation capability between the conditional and unconditional distributions, captured by an analytical model where the conditional distribution is a Gaussian mixture with means on an ellipsoid and the unconditional distribution is a single Gaussian approximating it.
